order_rule.text: Personal cards first, then business cards. Inside each: bank book tier, then spread the pulls across the three bureaus.

spacing.text: One at a time: wait for the decision before you send the next one. Never shotgun applications.

cannot_project: Credit scores. UnderwriteIQ reads your scores from a pull. It never guesses a new one, so every point uses today's scores.
Hard inquiries and late payments. UnderwriteIQ counts them but has no age window, so they stay as they are.
Banking history. UnderwriteIQ does not read bank deposits or how long you have banked somewhere.
New accounts, new businesses, or a new pull. Only what is on file today, plus your own plan.
Whether a dispute works. An "if removed" line shows what UnderwriteIQ would say. It is not a promise.

avalanche.label: Highest rate first
avalanche.detail: Extra money goes to the debt with the highest APR. Saves the most interest.
avalanche.source: Owner direction 2026-10-06: avalanche = highest APR first

utilization.label: Card use first
utilization.detail: Each card goes down to 10% of its limit, highest card use first. Then highest APR first.
utilization.source: src/blueprint/paydown-simulator.mjs allocateCashToCards (highest utilization first, each card to its 10% target)

snowball.label: Smallest balance first
snowball.detail: Extra money goes to the smallest balance. Closes debts sooner.
snowball.source: Owner direction 2026-10-06: snowball = smallest balance first

items.title: Government photo ID
items.ask: a photo of your driver's license or passport
items.ask_text: a photo of your driver's license or passport
items.label: Government photo ID
items.why: Every lender checks who you are first. The ID should show the address you live at now. If it does not, send your passport instead.

items.title: Proof of current address
items.ask: a recent utility bill or bank statement with your name and address
items.ask_text: a recent utility bill or bank statement with your name and address
items.label: Proof of current address
items.why: The name and address must match your ID. A utility bill or a bank statement both work.

items.title: Personal tax returns, last 2 years
items.ask: your personal tax returns for the last 2 years
items.ask_text: your personal tax returns for the last 2 years
items.label: Personal tax returns, last 2 years
items.why: Banks ask for them when the credit being approved gets large. Having them ready keeps the file moving.

items.title: Business bank statements, last 3 months
items.ask: your last 3 months of business bank statements
items.ask_text: your last 3 months of business bank statements for Sample Consulting LLC
items.label: Business bank statements, last 3 months — Sample Consulting LLC
items.why: Lenders read three months of statements to see money coming in and staying in the account.

expires.note: Lenders ask for the last three months; older than three months is no longer the last three.

items.title: Business tax returns, last 2 years
items.ask: your business tax returns for the last 2 years
items.ask_text: your business tax returns for the last 2 years for Sample Consulting LLC
items.label: Business tax returns, last 2 years — Sample Consulting LLC
items.why: Banks ask for them when the credit being approved gets large.

items.title: Articles of Organization
items.ask_text: your Articles of Organization (or Incorporation) for Sample Consulting LLC
items.label: Articles of Organization — Sample Consulting LLC
items.why: It proves the business exists and who owns it. The business name on it must match the name you apply under.

items.title: EIN confirmation letter
items.ask: your EIN confirmation letter from the IRS
items.ask_text: your EIN confirmation letter from the IRS for Sample Consulting LLC
items.label: EIN confirmation letter — Sample Consulting LLC
items.why: Banks match it to the business name before they open an account.

items.title: Certificate of Good Standing
items.ask: a Certificate of Good Standing from your Secretary of State, issued in the last 60 days
items.ask_text: a Certificate of Good Standing from your Secretary of State, issued in the last 60 days for Sample Consulting LLC
items.label: Certificate of Good Standing — Sample Consulting LLC
items.why: It shows the business is active with the state. Banks only take one issued in the last 60 days. You can order it online.
